say:3:1120740001:0.text: Please let us speak with your leader...
say:3:1120740001:0.source_cn: 让我们见见老大吧，求你了……

say:4:1120740002:0.text: I know it might seem hard to believe, but we really do want to make up for things. We brought meat and furs to give to everyone...
say:4:1120740002:0.source_cn: 我知道你们很难相信，但我们确实带着歉意前来，这些是我们...

say:5:1120740003:0.text: Enough of this fake compassion and endless lies, you thieving snakes! How would you like to lose your friends and family knowing their flesh is now likely fodder for the sand spiders?!
say:5:1120740003:0.source_cn: 收起虚伪的怜悯，谎话连篇，作恶多端的混蛋！你们也该尝尝...

say:6:1120740004:0.text: How do you possess the audacity to stand before us?! Be gone!
say:6:1120740004:0.source_cn: 你们怎么还有勇气站在部族门前？！还不快滚！

choice_prompt:7:1120740004.text: How do you possess the audacity to stand before us?! Be gone!
choice_prompt:7:1120740004.source_cn: 你们怎么还有勇气站在部族门前？！还不快滚！

say:8:1120740005:0.text: If you wish to show true courage, face your sins and pay with blood! Because of you, my brother left and never returned!
say:8:1120740005:0.source_cn: 你们有勇气，那就直面罪过，血债血偿吧！我的哥哥走了，就...

say:9:1120740006:0.text: If striking me will ease your pain, fire away.
say:9:1120740006:0.source_cn: 如果揍我能让你出气的话，那就来吧。

say:11:1120740008:0.text: There's no denying what the Quicksand Claws did! We followed Ferranc blindly, and that's on us!
say:11:1120740008:0.source_cn: 我们不会否认流沙之爪做过暴行！盲从弗兰克而没有断绝和流...

say:12:1120740009:0.text: You've got some guts! Better make your peace and prepare to get thrashed!
say:12:1120740009:0.source_cn: 哼，还算有胆量！那你咬紧牙齿，准备挨揍吧——

say:18:1120740011:0.text: Chief Chulain?! Please let me kill this Claw scum in your honor!
say:18:1120740011:0.source_cn: ……库胡林族长？！这些流沙之爪竟然惊动了你，我这就把他...

say:19:1120740012:0.text: Chief, it's true that Rumon and I were a part of the Quicksand Claws, but we really have come to ask for your forgiveness...
say:19:1120740012:0.source_cn: 族、族长，我和卢玛，我们是流沙之爪没错，但我们这次来是...

say:23:1120740013:0.text: Is this the Quicksand Claw you nominated for the Bestial Brawl?
say:23:1120740013:0.male: Is this the Quicksand Claw you nominated for the Bestial Brawl?
say:23:1120740013:0.female: Is this the Quicksand Claw you nominated for the Bestial Brawl?

choice_prompt:24:1120740013.text: Is this the Quicksand Claw you nominated for the Bestial Brawl?
choice_prompt:24:1120740013.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style><male>先生</male><female>女士</female>，他就是你之前说的，那个愿意参加斗兽演祀的流沙之爪？
choice_prompt:24:1120740013.male: Is this the Quicksand Claw you nominated for the Bestial Brawl?
choice_prompt:24:1120740013.female: Is this the Quicksand Claw you nominated for the Bestial Brawl?

say:25:1120740014:0.text: He's hardly more than a child...
say:25:1120740014:0.male: He's hardly more than a child...
say:25:1120740014:0.female: He's hardly more than a child...

say:26:1120740015:0.text: I've never seen your faces... Most of you children only act on orders from above, and the Eroded Enclave is cruel to adults, let alone younglings who have no one to depend on. I choose not to begrudge your actions against our clan.
say:26:1120740015:0.source_cn: 我没见过你们的脸……你们这些小孩多半也只是听上头的命令...

say:27:1120740016:0.text: But these apologies that have come so late will not bring back the ones we've lost. Take your things and return to where you came!
say:27:1120740016:0.source_cn: 但我们也不会因此而原谅流沙之爪的罪孽，逝者已矣……拿走...

say:28:1120740017:0.text: I don't expect you to forgive the Claws!
say:28:1120740017:0.source_cn: ——我没想让你们原谅流沙之爪！

say:29:1120740018:0.text: I know the Claws have done a lot of bad things, and even if we weren't totally involved, we're still connected to what they did. Those perpetrators will never come to apologize, but Rumon and I have.
say:29:1120740018:0.source_cn: 我……我知道流沙之爪做了很多错事，虽然没有亲自参与其中...

say:30:1120740019:0.text: I'm so sorry... I truly am... The lives lost can't be replaced, but if our apology can somehow ease your pain, then we'll say them again and again until our voices give out.
say:30:1120740019:0.source_cn: ……对不起！真的很对不起！逝去的生命无论如何也无法挽回...

say:31:1120740020:0.text: This is why I want to fight in the Bestial Brawl. If a Claw can have the courage to face his crimes head-on with an open heart... I think that might be something the Dusk Lord might smile upon.
say:31:1120740020:0.source_cn: 也是因为这个原因，我才想要参加斗兽演祀。如果曾经作恶的...

say:32:1120740021:0.text: I hope what I've said has not dirtied the name of the Dusk Lord.
say:32:1120740021:0.source_cn: ……希望我的揣测没有玷污残阳神的神圣。

say:33:1120740022:0.text: ... Magister, what are your honest thoughts on this youngling?
say:33:1120740022:0.male: ... Magister, what are your honest thoughts on this youngling?
say:33:1120740022:0.female: ... Magister, what are your honest thoughts on this youngling?

choice_prompt:34:1120740022.text: ... Magister, what are your honest thoughts on this youngling?
choice_prompt:34:1120740022.source_cn: ……魔法师<male>先生</male><female>女士</female>，你觉得这个人，怎么样？
choice_prompt:34:1120740022.male: ... Magister, what are your honest thoughts on this youngling?
choice_prompt:34:1120740022.female: ... Magister, what are your honest thoughts on this youngling?

say:36:1120740024:0.text: *Sigh*... With the assurance of the magister, I believe you are sincere. If you truly have the heart to redeem yourself, go and convince my people the same.
say:36:1120740024:0.male: *Sigh*... With the assurance of the magister, I believe you are sincere. If you truly have the heart to redeem yourself, go and convince my people the same.
say:36:1120740024:0.female: *Sigh*... With the assurance of the magister, I believe you are sincere. If you truly have the heart to redeem yourself, go and convince my people the same.

say:37:1120740025:0.text: If you gain the approval of the clan, you may fight in the Bestial Brawl. If they support you, so shall I.
say:37:1120740025:0.source_cn: 只要能在部落内获得族人的认可，你就可以参加斗兽演祀。如...

say:38:1120740026:0.text: Really? I... I'll try my best!

choice:34:0:1.text: He's willing to fight for you.
choice:34:0:1.source_cn: 他有完成斗兽演祀的决心
choice:34:0:1.male: He's willing to fight for you.
choice:34:0:1.female: He's willing to fight for you.

choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 流沙之爪也不全是坏人

choice:7:2:3.source_cn: 这份勇气确实值得赞扬！
